title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 6 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 6 De hujus mundi fine COMPLETE (mid PHYS 372-mid-381 before CAPUT SEPTIMUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 6 On the end of this world, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 372–mid-381): Cap. 6 title; names of the end; against Didymus and eternity philosophers; fire proper; starry heaven; substance vs qualities / renovation; timing unknown; rabbinic millennia; signs; pastoral use — Cap. 6 close. Cap. 7 starts mid PHYS 381. Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1–5 COMPLETE (english not modified).
